The tank has a white logo and text 'GEEPEE' on the front, visible in all three photos.
The tank appears to be made of thick plastic with horizontal corrugations for structural strength.
There is visible dust and minor surface wear on the tank's surface.
A small circular opening is visible near the bottom, likely for drainage or filling.
The tank is standing on a base, possibly for stability.
No capacity markings (e.g., 1000L) are visible on the tank in any photo.
The tank is in a storage or warehouse setting, surrounded by other similar tanks.
